text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] log-rule `auth-502-spike` triggered -> 502 rate spike on `auth` (sev=2). Alert link: https://redwood.ai/alerts/12345 :rotating_light:

sergio: seeing a flood of these alerts — ~120 502s/min in the last 5m. paging kicked. are customers actually hitting these or is this noise?

maya: i'm oncall, investigating. quick look at logs shows large bulk from internal probes hitting `/health?check=1` and `kube-probe` UA. looks internal but noisy. still validating if any external tenant saw failed auth.

aditya: query for rule today is basically: `service="auth" AND status_code="502" | count_over_time([5m]) > 50` — so yes, anything that returns 502 counts. we need to exclude health checks and kube probes.

sergio: proposal for live mitigation: (1) mute pager for 30m, (2) bump threshold to 200 temporarily, (3) patch alert query to exclude paths/UA, (4) follow up with a proper signature to ignore kube-probe and internal CIDRs. who can do the quick changes? :pray:

maya: I can mute the pager and open a PR for the alert tweak. doing mute now.

maya: quick query patch i'm pushing in PR (#1214):
```
# previous rule snippet
service = "auth" AND status_code = "502"
# proposed (temporary)
service = "auth" AND status_code = "502" AND NOT path =~ "^/health" AND NOT user_agent =~ "kube-probe"
```

aditya: also add `AND NOT client_ip IN ("10.0.0.0/8","192.168.0.0/16")` to catch internal ranges. regex for UA is fine but let's add negative IP signature too.

lisa: quick customer-impact note: two paid tenants reported intermittent auth failures ~ 10-12 users each, but retries cleared them. we should flag those sessions for a follow-up with CS. taking trace samples now.

sergio: good call. we should record exact tenant IDs and sample trace ids in the incident ticket. i will create INF-4573 and assign owner for customer follow-up + postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager muted by maya at https://redwood.ai/pager/789 (reason: suspected health-check noise).

maya: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/1214 — includes query tweak + description + smoke test. bumped alert threshold to 200 for 15m via temp config. screenshot attached in PR. :white_check_mark:

aditya: LGTM on the query. after merge, add a unit test in the alert suite that feeds a synthetic `kube-probe` log and asserts no trigger. also add a dashboard panel: 502s by path / user_agent.

lisa: handoff — i'm taking on-call for the next 4h. watching dashboards and traces. if any external tenant errors increase, i'll escalate to sev1 and @sergio.

sergio: thanks. post-incident follow-ups (assigned):
- INF-4573: postmortem + customer impact (owner: sergio)
- PR 1214: merge alert rule tweak + add unit test (owner: maya/aditya)
- Dashboard: add heatmap + per-tenant trace sampling (owner: aditya)
- Runbook: add step to check `user_agent` and `path` before muting (owner: lisa)

maya: merging PR now. will monitor for 30m and unmute earlier if things look stable.

aditya: once merged, i'll push a signature file (alerts/signatures/internal-probes.yaml) that lists `kube-probe` and the internal CIDRs. also adding a regex to avoid matching tokenized health-checks.

lisa: confirmed no further external 502 spikes in last 10m. will keep monitoring. :thumbsup:

sergio: nice work team. action items in ticket. i'll send a short incident digest to #product and #support once we have tenant list.

maya: handing back to sergio after 30m unless lisa sees something. thanks everyone. :heart:

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED by maya (muted->resolved) at 1773506068"
